summary: Adds an authored document-flow map generated from the compiler's final primary-section inventory.

evidence.sourceGrammar: The top-level leaf directive ::contents accepts no attributes, label, children, author HTML, script, template, callback, URL, resource, or manifest default. Invalid forms, attributes and nested placement fail with authored-range diagnostics and appear in generated discovery and schemas.
evidence.executionCapabilities: After final section IDs and appendix extraction, trusted HAST enhancement replaces the directive placeholder with a labelled native navigation landmark and ordered links. Exact visible section headings populate the in-flow map; optional short nav labels remain exclusive to sidebar chrome.
evidence.confinement: The transformation consumes only the already confined document HAST and allocates no path or ID. It reads no additional source, file, URL, environment value or generated artifact.
evidence.offlineBehavior: Compilation and direct file-URL reading require no network or service. Links are same-document fragments to compiler-final section targets.
evidence.deterministicSerialization: Final explicit sections, or eligible legacy H2 headings when no explicit section exists, determine exact order, labels and hrefs. Zero and one-item maps remain in flow while sidebar chrome keeps its independent two-item threshold.
evidence.cspAndRuntime: The feature serializes native nav, ordered-list and same-page anchor elements before output. It adds no browser parser, listener, observer, handler, storage, script, style input, form, iframe, fetch, CSP source or runtime branch.
evidence.accessibility: The map is a labelled navigation landmark with a visible localized title, ordered native links and exact visible section names. It remains ordinary article content at narrow widths instead of moving into the modal contents drawer.
evidence.byteAndPerformanceBudgets: One final structural section traversal supplies both in-flow and sidebar projections. Work is linear in document elements and section count, with no duplicate HTML parse, reader-time scan, scroll work or background task.
evidence.packageDependenciesAndLicenses: No dependency or license is added. The implementation composes the typed registry, existing Markdown/HAST pipeline, section ID allocator, localization strings, static document shell and shared CSS tokens.
evidence.compatibility: Sources without ::contents retain current output behavior. Explicit and legacy sidebar navigation, current-section ownership, review targets, appendix exclusion, output formats, CSP and runtime stay unchanged; the new directive is additive within source contract major 1.
